basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old software developer from Springfield, Illinois, with a passion for mobile gaming and urban planning. In my free time, I love exploring new cities and playing Pokémon Go. I often play during lunch breaks and evenings. I'm currently single and enjoy learning about sustainable urban development through online courses and community discussions. My work involves building web applications, which aligns perfectly with my interests in technology and urban infrastructure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working as a software developer for over 3 years. My interest in urban planning is self-taught, primarily through YouTube channels like 'Not Just Bikes' and related subreddits. I enjoy learning about how urban design affects lifestyle and community.
